summary: Chase Hill lookout in Canaan, Somerset County, Maine: erected in 1931 per the state forest commissioner's report; listed as standing; reachable by a 0.6-mile hike.

facts.agency: Maine forest commissioner (1931 annual report, as quoted by Eastern US Lookouts)

access.note: A 2024 hiker's guide gives directions and describes climbing the staircase; it mentions no gate, closure or permission requirement. Land ownership is not stated in the sources read.

visit.trail_note: 0.6-mile round trip on an eroded jeep track. From Lancaster Road in Canaan, take unpaved Chase Hill Road about 0.9 miles to an eroded road on the left and park off to the side.

events.note: Erected in the fall of 1931; the state annual report names Chase Hill in Somerset County among the new lookout sites

evidence.supports: fall 1931 decision to fill gaps in lookout coverage
evidence.quote: In the Fall of 1931 it was decided to do away with the handicap of certain districts not having a lookout tower.

evidence.supports: five new forty-seven-foot steel stations and one dismantled station erected on peaks in the organized towns
evidence.quote: After a careful survey, five new forty-seven foot steel lookout stations and one dismantled one were erected on peaks in the Organized Towns

evidence.supports: a lookout was erected on Chase Hill in Somerset County
evidence.quote: A lookout was erected on Chase Hill in Somerset County.

evidence.supports: tower condition: pretty good shape, minus a few planks
evidence.quote: The tower is set within an open area of ledge and is in pretty good shape, minus a few planks.

evidence.supports: staircase climb and heavy cloud obscuring the views on the visit day
evidence.quote: Even those scared of heights might find climbing the staircase to views above the tree canopy not too terrifying.

evidence.supports: heavy cloud obscured views on the day visited
evidence.quote: Unfortunately, on the day I visited, heavy cloud coverage obscured the views.

evidence.supports: 0.6-mile round trip on an eroded jeep track
evidence.quote: The 0.6-mile hike (round trip) to the Chase tower follows an eroded jeep track that is short and moderately easy.

evidence.supports: directions from Lancaster Road, 0.9 miles on unpaved Chase Hill Road, park off to the side
evidence.quote: Follow it for 0.9 miles until you reach an eroded road on your left. Turn in here and park off to the side.

evidence.supports: Lancaster Road access; Chase Hill Road is unpaved
evidence.quote: From Lancaster Road in Canaan, turn onto Chase Hill Road, which is unpaved.

evidence.supports: listed as standing in the Maine list

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The brief lists Eastern US Lookouts as showing the tower gone. The cached Eastern US page quotes only the 1931 report and states no status, so the tower is recorded as standing on the strength of the FFLA Maine list and the 2024 visit account.

notes_for_editor: Built 1931 is supported only by the state report as quoted on the Eastern US Lookouts page; no primary copy of the report was read. Staffing history and the original design of this tower are not found. Access is recorded as public from a single 2024 hiker's guide with no owner named; confirm land status before publishing a visiting note. A Canaan Historical Society post and a Forest Fire Lookout Association Maine chapter post mention 1931 and aging stairs, but Facebook returned only page titles, so they are not cited.
